## Summary

- Split `test/registered/e2e/models/test_deepseek_v41_flash_gb300.py` into one file per server configuration, so each one partitions independently across the `4-gpu-gb300` runners instead of running all four servers back to back in a single file:
  - `test_deepseek_v41_flash_gb300_tp4ep4.py`: TP4 + EP4
  - `test_deepseek_v41_flash_gb300_dp4ep4.py`: DP-attention4 + EP4
  - `test_deepseek_v41_flash_gb300_bounded_replay_bcg.py`: TP4 + EP4 with decoder SWA bounded replay in breakable prefill graphs
  - `test_deepseek_v41_flash_gb300_trtllm_bounded_bcg.py`: TRT-LLM attention with bounded replay in breakable prefill graphs
- Move the shared DSPARK accuracy mixin (GSM8K + MMMU-Pro, draft-acceptance check) to `sglang.test.dsv41_flash_common`.
- Test coverage is unchanged: the same 4 configurations × 2 evals (8 cases), with the same thresholds.

@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+"""DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash + DSPARK accuracy on four GB300 GPUs: bounded replay BCG.
+
+TP4 + EP4 with decoder SWA bounded replay inside breakable prefill graphs,
+using the default attention backend.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.dsv41_flash_common import TP4_EP4_ARGS, DSV41FlashAccuracyMixin
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=600, stage="base-c", runner_config="4-gpu-gb300")
+
+
+class TestDSV41FlashTP4EP4DSparkBoundedReplayBCG(
+    DSV41FlashAccuracyMixin, CustomTestCase
+):
+    """Exercise bounded late-layer replay inside the breakable prefill graph."""
+
+    parallel_args = TP4_EP4_ARGS
+    # Leave memory for the prefill graph pool. With 32 requests, the tail
+    # capacity is 4096 rows, below the largest 8192-token capture shape.
+    mem_fraction_static = "0.7"
+    max_running_requests = "32"
+    graph_args = [
+        "--enable-decoder-swa-bounded-replay",
+        "--cuda-graph-backend-prefill",
+        "breakable",
+        "--cuda-graph-max-bs-prefill",
+        "8192",
+        "--chunked-prefill-size",
+        "8192",
+    ]
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+"""DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash + DSPARK accuracy on four GB300 GPUs: DP-attention4 + EP4.
+
+The DP+EP recipe is intentionally exercised rather than skipped: startup or
+accuracy failures must be visible in CI while this path is being validated.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.dsv41_flash_common import DSV41FlashAccuracyMixin
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=600, stage="base-c", runner_config="4-gpu-gb300")
+
+
+class TestDSV41FlashDP4EP4DSpark(DSV41FlashAccuracyMixin, CustomTestCase):
+    """DP attention and EP MoE using the built-in gather/reduce path.
+
+    DSPARK with DP attention does not support the DeepEP backend.
+    """
+
+    parallel_args = [
+        "--attn-dp-size",
+        "4",
+        "--ep-size",
+        "4",
+        "--enable-dp-lm-head",
+        "--moe-a2a-backend",
+        "none",
+    ]
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+
+GSM8K and MMMU-Pro with tensor-parallel attention and expert-parallel MoE,
+without DP attention.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.dsv41_flash_common import TP4_EP4_ARGS, DSV41FlashAccuracyMixin
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=600, stage="base-c", runner_config="4-gpu-gb300")
+
+
+class TestDSV41FlashTP4EP4DSpark(DSV41FlashAccuracyMixin, CustomTestCase):
+    """Tensor-parallel attention and expert-parallel MoE, without DP attention."""

+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash + DSPARK accuracy on four GB300 GPUs: TRT-LLM bounded BCG.
+
+TP4 + EP4 with TRT-LLM varlen attention and decoder SWA bounded replay inside
+breakable prefill graphs.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.dsv41_flash_common import DSV41FlashAccuracyMixin
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=600, stage="base-c", runner_config="4-gpu-gb300")
+
+
+class TestDSV41FlashTrtllmBoundedBCG(DSV41FlashAccuracyMixin, CustomTestCase):
+    """TRT-LLM varlen attention through the full and bounded-tail graph breaks."""
+
+    parallel_args = [
+        "--attn-dp-size",
+        "1",
+        "--ep-size",
+        "4",
+        "--dsv4-attn-backend",
+        "trtllm",
+        "--enable-decoder-swa-bounded-replay",
+        "--cuda-graph-backend-prefill",
+        "breakable",
+        "--cuda-graph-max-bs-prefill",
+        "4096",
+        "--cuda-graph-max-seq-len-prefill",
+        "16384",
+        "--chunked-prefill-size",
+        "4096",
+    ]
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
